text: {"status":"ANSWERED","claims":[{"text":"Secrets must never be stored in chat messages or in email.","evidence_id":"E3","quote":"Secrets must never be stored in source code, in configuration files committed to a repository, in tickets, in chat messages or in email."},{"text":"If a secret is pasted into a chat, it must be revoked or rotated immediately and reported as a security incident.","evidence_id":"E2","quote":"If a secret is exposed, for example committed to a repository or pasted into a chat, it must be revoked or rotated immediately and reported as a security incident under the Incident Response Policy."},{"text":"Access to systems holding Restricted information requires approval from the data owner of that system.","evidence_id":"E5","quote":"Access to systems holding Confidential or Restricted information also requires approval from the data owner of that system."}],"conflict_evidence_ids":[],"conflict_note":""}
